# P37.27 — Graph explorer B (K2 GX-09b)

The second wave of the `/explore/` T2 surface over P37.26's landed island — expansion, facet filters, search-to-node, the path finder, the hops ring, and the keyboard-accessible sortable node list.

- **`expand=`** — ego expansion via the new `sig.entity-twins/1` manifest endpoint (`/entity/<type>/<key>/index.json`); ≤ 10 expanded nodes, ≤ 3,000 on canvas — a cap is disclosed; a twin-less node answers typed (`no machine-readable twin`), never a fabricated ego.
- **Filters** — `kind`/`edge`/`currency`/`dated`/`source`/`jurisdiction`/`technology` facets over the loaded graph only; every field 1:1 onto a registered workspace parameter; the `active-filters` note discloses the narrowed view (H-3/H-9 — never reads as the whole).
- **Search-to-node** — `q=` over the loaded graph + the shared K3 typeahead shards for entities outside the overview (`search-node-hit`/`search-entity-hit`/`search-link-hit`/`search-empty`).
- **Path finder** — `path=<a>~<b>` BFS over the loaded graph: every hop evidenced (`island-path-hop`), >3 hops SPECULATIVE (`speculative-label`), typed `path-none`/`path-same`/`path-missing` — SIG-UI-120.
- **Hops ring + sortable list** — `hops=` 1|2 neighbourhood ring around the focus (`hops-note`); `explore-node-table` with `sort=`/`dir=` aria-pressed keyboard sort.

**Requirement ids:** owns no §56 `Owner:` — serves/cites SIG-UI-119/120 (the round-trip + path answers the P37.26 owner rows minted), SIG-UI-037/060/121, SIG-RECON-049; UXR-09 carried as a draft.
